work: First live AI-release pass: ran against the window-closed seeded candidate, fixed the pass's CLI handling bugs, recorded the platform signing wall, and made the app's AI-release copy honest

sweepPass.target: The campaign seeded 2026-10-03 on preview 3d51d15a1492131c8933187f (escrow adpad_esc_2d58ddd9-5dfe-474a-bbec-1bc6c4d6303c, aiRelease true, proof submitted 2026-10-03T16:02:44Z, objection window opened 2026-10-03T22:02:44Z)
sweepPass.previewState: extend_preview on the old preview was refused (preview_expired) at 2026-10-04T15:39Z; its data still answered reads, so the pass ran against it while it lasted.
scriptBugsFound: The pass read raw.id, but the CLI returns documents with _id/pathId and no id field, so the candidate's review was looked up at proofReviews/undefined and skipped as 'awaiting-review'. Fixed by deriving the id from pathId/_id.

getDoc assumed every data get returns a list; a single-document get returns the document object itself and a missing one returns data: null, so the pass could never have read a review or confirmed an action receipt. Fixed to handle null, array and object shapes.
Both bugs were invisible to the policy suite, which proves the rule path through the sandbox harness, not the agent's CLI data lane. Only a live pass against real CLI output could catch them.
sweepPass.attempt: With the fixes the pass correctly identified the candidate (opted-in, submitted, window closed, real meets-terms review of the exact proof, run 1) and assembled the single-use aiRelease action carrying the full public attestation (verdict, reviewProofUrl, reviewRun, reviewReviewedAt).
sweepPass.refusal: The action write was refused by the platform before any rule ran: 'this write requires a client-signed Solana transaction, and your web login has no local signing key'. The agent account on this computer authenticates through the platform-pinned web session (BOUNDED_ACCOUNT_FILE, keySource web); no CLI keypair exists to switch to, and the platform's authority reference states the agent cannot sign onchain transactions for the app. bounded account use is blocked while the platform pins the process account, and generating a new keypair would create a different address the rules rightly refuse.
sweepPass.noRetry: The refusal is definitive (nothing landed: head unchanged at version 3, status submitted, no attestation document created). Per payment discipline no retry was made and nothing was forced or faked.
sweepPass.conclusion: The on-ledger AI release is blocked at the platform layer, not in the app: the rule path is proven by the time-controlled policy suite (25-ai-release.json), but the execution leg needs a platform capability that does not exist today - function-signed onchain verdicts, or a signing key for the pinned agent. Until one exists the app must not promise automatic release, so the UI copy was corrected in this commit.

honestyFix.scope: src/App.tsx, src/config.ts (new AGENT_WALLET constant matching the policy's AGENT_ADDRESS)
copyChanges: Funding opt-in now says the review clears the payment for release and states plainly: the automatic release is not live yet, until the platform switches it on a matching review stands as the public record and the advertiser releases with one click.
The escrow notice at booking no longer says the AI proof review approves payment; approval is the advertiser's, the review clears.
Campaign views for advertiser, publisher, admin and bystander now describe the payment as cleared for the app's automatic release, with the not-live-yet caveat and the one-click manual path.

The settled message no longer credits any non-advertiser release to the AI: an AI release is reported only when resolvedBy equals the pinned agent address (AGENT_WALLET), an admin release says an admin decision released it, everything else stays 'Delivery approved'.
honestyFix.policyUntouched: No rule, field or invariant changed; policy.json regenerated by scripts/generate-policy.mjs and byte-identical.

applicationTests.skippedFile: tests/listing-helpers.live.test.ts (live backend test, skipped in unit runs)

browserChecks.bookingDialog: The dialog shows the corrected opt-in label verbatim ('Authorize the AI proof review to clear this payment for release... The automatic release is not live yet...') and the corrected escrow notice; the Sign in to book gate is unchanged for guests.

Their copy is verified by build and unit tests; their data paths by the recorded live SDK checks of 2026-10-03.

notVerifiedLive: No AI release has executed on the ledger in any environment. The allow path is proven only by the time-controlled policy suite; the live execution leg is blocked by the platform signing model recorded above. The old preview (3d51d15a1492131c8933187f) with the seeded candidate expired this run and will be deleted with its data by the platform.
